Identify DHS microdata files

Source: R/identify.R
bdhs_identify_file.Rd

Works out which survey round and recode each file holds, so that files can be imported whatever they are called. Standard DHS names (BDIR81FL.DTA, BDKR7RDT.ZIP, lower-case or prefixed, e.g. 2022BDPR81FL.DTA) are recognised from the name alone (their variable names are checked against the recode). Renamed files such as BDHS2018KR.DTA or SPA2014_FC.dta are recognised from the year and recode code in the name and must be confirmed by their content: a Bangladesh country code (v000, hv000 or mv000) and the identifier variables of the recode. Anything else is identified from its content, reading only the header and a few columns (v000/hv000, v007/hv007 and the identifier variables).

Usage

bdhs_identify_file(path)

Arguments

path

Paths to files, folders (searched recursively) or zip archives (their members are listed, not extracted).

Value

A tibble with one row per data file and columns path, file_stem (the DHS file stem, e.g. "BDIR81FL"), survey_id, recode, format, method ("filename" or "content"), derived and note.

Details

Files whose name and content disagree (another round, recode or country), and renamed files that their content does not confirm, are left unidentified (survey_id and recode are NA) with a warning; the note column says why. bdhs_import() does not import them.

Derived files – several rounds appended together, or files with variables that are not in the DHS recode – are flagged with derived = TRUE. bdhs_import() skips them, because bdhs only stores original DHS files.

See also

Other data store: bdhs_data_dir(), bdhs_download(), bdhs_forget(), bdhs_import(), bdhs_inventory(), bdhs_read(), bdhs_read_file(), bdhs_sitrep()

Examples

f <- file.path(tempdir(), "BDHS2022KR.dta")
haven::write_dta(bdhs_simulate(2022, "KR", n_clusters = 4, households = 3), f)
bdhs_identify_file(f)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   path                    file_stem survey_id recode format method derived note 
#>   <chr>                   <chr>     <chr>     <chr>  <chr>  <chr>  <lgl>   <chr>
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpaceObh/BDHS20… BDKR81FL  BD2022DHS KR     dta    filen… FALSE   NA
